corrections.text: The article states, in the "What We Don't Know" section, that Waymo issued a recall of "over 3,800 robotaxis" "over risk entering closed construction zones," attributing this to The Drive. The Drive's cited article does not contain this claim (verified against the source snapshot). The underlying fact is accurate and independently verifiable — Waymo recalled roughly 3,800-3,900 robotaxis in June 2026 after vehicles drove into active freeway construction zones — but it was reported by outlets not cited in this article (e.g., CNBC, Gizmodo, Detroit News), not by The Drive.
